pool.text: Both European settlements essentially collapsed after the Dutch formally left the area.
A railway was built in Sekondi and Takoradi to transport important regional resources.
Ghana's first deepwater seaport was constructed in Takoradi to boost economic sectors.
The two separate cities of Sekondi and Takoradi amalgamated after the war.
The city officially became the seat of the Roman Catholic Diocese.
Heavy rainfall caused rivers to overflow, rendering more than 1,000 people homeless.
The discovery of oil in the region led to the title Oil City.
Abdul-Mumin Issah served as the mayor according to census and official records.
Kwabena Okyere Darko-Mensah commissioned a new 60-bed polyclinic in New Takoradi.
Frederick F took office as the mayor of the city and metropolitan area.
